caption:
You walk in thinking you’re free to choose. You never were.

In 1916, a grocer tore out the counter and called it « self-service. » In 1937, another one hired actors to push his new carts until everyone copied them. Today, brands rent the shelf at your eye level, the end of every aisle is for sale, and the music sets your pace.

The store was drawn before you walked in.
